meta.dc:title: Public Law 118–42: Making consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024, and for other purposes.

longTitle.officialTitle:
Making consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024, and for other purposes.
Mar. 9, 2024

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2024”.

appropriations.heading: Military Construction, Army
appropriations.content: For acquisition, construction, installation, and equipment of temporary or permanent public works, $2,022,775,000, to remain available until September 30, 2028.

section.content: None of the funds made available in this title shall be expended for payments under a cost-plus-a-fixed-fee contract.
Funds made available by this division may be used as provided in section 2209b of title 7, United States Code and section 2 of Public Law 118–5.
